=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/alert_self_fix_break_glass.sh:abg_test | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `--tests-only` list (`(cd "${ABG_HEAD_DIR}" && find tests -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name 'test_*.py' -o -name 'test_*.sh' \) 2>/dev/null | LC_ALL=C sort) > "${tests_file}"`) has 549 entries, but the gate caps it at 500. The chain is `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py` line 135 `MAX_TESTS_FILE_ENTRIES = 500`, then `parse_tests_file` lines 1673-1675 `tests_file_too_many_entries`, then line 1111 `unverified`, then lines 1151-1152 `status = "unverified"`.
  WHY: Every candidate maps to `tests_unverified`, so "Post break-glass status" never runs. It fails closed, but break-glass can never post a pass. The 3-file fixture and fake gate miss this. Suggested fix: split into chunks of at most 500 (`split -l 500`), run the gate once per chunk, and require `pass` from all chunks.

  WHY: Nothing breaks at runtime, but operators would read the wrong test list once the fragment folds into agents.md.

"${tests_file}")" -gt 500 ]; then _abg_eval "${pr}" "${head}" 5 false too_many_tests; return 0; fi` and add `too_many_tests` to the ALERT_BREAK_GLASS reason list in the fragment.
